answer: A decaying identity bond stops fakes. Each agent posts a 300 POA onyx bond to join; it shrinks 5% per epoch unless work tops it up. Quiet identities fade from the ocean of members and must re-bond in full. A comet sweep every 10th epoch drops bonds under 100 POA. Forging 1,000 fakes costs 300,000 POA, and decay drains 15,000 per epoch, more than their split of the 25,000 pool repays. An honest agent pays 300 once and keeps its undiluted reward.
